about: Public storage rules and read-only admission defaults. Machine locations and cleanup selections come from config/storage_policy.local.json below LSS_PRIVATE_ROOT. Deletion and relocation require that overlay and nonempty protection lists.

disposable.about: Regenerable by definition: pytest temporary roots, Python caches, WebView2 profiles of test cases. Deleted, never carried to the HDD; receipt in local_state_root.

scratch_runs.about: Finished acceptance and post-deploy runs are deleted on the SSD every hourly pass once idle: copied packages, models, media, audio and databases go; JSON/Markdown/log Evidence up to keep_max_mb stays in place. Links inside a run are never entered.

unused_local_models.about: Delete only idle folders explicitly marked retired with complete lss-model.json provenance and verified per-file SHA256, no saved profile/preset, tracked script/config or process reference, and no keep entry. UNKNOWN stays with a reason in receipts/status. Nested .cache is ordinary content requiring the same provenance; it is never implicitly disposable. Never archive to HDD.

storage_budget.about: Development job admission: free GB minus outstanding peak-growth estimates must cover floor_gb plus the new estimate. Estimates remain reserved until child-tree exit; default_job_gb is a provisional conservative baseline, not a measured bound. Larger jobs declare --storage-gb or queue storage_gb. Active lexical/resolved paths protect movers; only explicit archive_paths request completion archival.

dirty_worktree_about: A worktree with uncommitted or untracked work is retired once nothing in it has been written for this many hours: every untracked file, every modified tracked file and the full diff against HEAD (UNCOMMITTED.patch) are archived and verified first, the branch is kept.

run_only_while_developing.about: Legacy auto admission only. The OS scheduled entry runs without an agent; idle ages, process and storage-reservation guards still protect active work.

stage.about: Verified read-only reference cache on the configured SSD, with LRU eviction and a 120 GB cap. Capacity checks use the resolved cache volume. Eviction and cache replacement require the machine overlay; permanent model stores are not cache entries.

worktree_promote.about: storage_tiers.py promote moves a worktree to the machine-configured SSD root after a verified copy, repairs git registration and leaves a junction at the old path. The free-space floor and active-commit age apply to the configured volume.

protected_packages_about: Package copies (LSS.exe + _internal) are rebuilt from their commit and deleted, except these, every package path named in .state/releases/**/*product*.json, and builds of FROZEN-* candidates without a closing verdict file.
model_stores_about: Canonical model stores stay. A stray model is a duplicate only after matching SHA256 with a canonical original; filename and size only narrow candidates.
superseded_models_about: In a canonical model store on the SSD, an acquisition revision `<name>-r<N>` is superseded once a later revision of the same name holds a weight file and no staging leftover; an abandoned download (`.staging*` directory or `*.part` file) is a leftover. Both are re-downloadable: deleted when idle and named by no running process, with a receipt.
user_cleanups_about: Machine-selected regenerable leftovers are removed at their configured cadence through tool-owned commands or idle-age rules. Public defaults select nothing. Cleanup preserves user data, settings and package repair sources; NuGet global-packages is never a cleanup target.
prune_roots_about: HDD development roots are pruned weekly. Metadata selects regenerable directories; candidate model copies require SHA256 verification before deletion.

retention.about: Scheduler retires dependency-checked old generated validation stems, preserves JSON/hash receipts, and archives verified legacy pre-run.json payloads with junctions under the Product owner lock. Current/held modern runs stay.

dependency_inventory_about: Disabled in scheduled cleanup: machine-wide dependency inspection does not reclaim bytes and needlessly visits unrelated applications. Explicit read-only inventory remains available; historical errors are retained.
